name: Blade of Yogg-Saron rank 2 is in the Heretic tab, not General
contract: Issue #11676. Blade of Yogg-Saron rank 1 (524887) is in SkillLine 90 (Heretic) through SkillLineAbility row 24171, while rank 2 (525078) had no row and the client filed it under General. SkillLineAbility row 842, a duplicate of row 12782 for spell 13809 that differs only in MinSkillLineRank, is repurposed for 525078 at SkillLine 90, the line of rank 1, and the client data carries the same row, which the harness does not observe.
